_readme: KITH instant-quote price book. Edit numbers here; the website and the AI estimate both read this file. All customer-facing prices include VAT. Labour follows SOP v8 retail: LOW tier for servicing and brakes, TOP for everything else; multiplier x2 under 2.0 hrs, x1.5 at 2.0 hrs and over; 'x2' jobs are always x2. Hours and parts ranges per vehicle size are STARTING ASSUMPTIONS to be checked by KITH before launch.

dealer._note: Main dealer comparison. With use_multiplier on, the dealer figure is simply our price times multiplier -- KITH reports a franchised dealer at roughly half as much again for the same work. The labour_rate/parts_factor model below is the alternative: it works the dealer figure out from book hours at their rate, which varies honestly by job but on short jobs shows almost no gap. Shown as a typical average, never as a quote for a named garage.

jobs.name: Dent repair (per dent)
jobs.note: Small dings with the paint intact sit at the low end; creased or painted repairs cost more.

jobs.name: Accident damage (insurance or private)
jobs.note: Send us photos and we'll price it properly. We can deal with your insurer for you.

jobs.name: Clutch replacement
jobs.note: Upper end allows for a dual mass flywheel. We check it when the gearbox is out and confirm before fitting.

jobs.name: Timing chain replacement
jobs.note: Varies a lot by engine. Some chains sit at the back and need the engine out, which we confirm before quoting in writing.

jobs.name: Front drop links (pair)
jobs.note: Knocking over bumps is usually a drop link before it is anything dearer.

jobs.name: Diagnostic code read
jobs.label: £36 fixed
includes: Every stored and pending fault code read, across all modules the car exposes
What each code means in plain English, written down
Freeze-frame data saved so the fault can be traced later if it is intermittent
Deducted from the full diagnostic if the fault needs one
jobs.note: Reads what the car has stored and tells you what triggered the light. It does not test the component: where the codes do not name the fault outright, the full diagnostic below is the next step and this fee comes off it.

jobs.name: Full diagnostic
jobs.label: £146 fixed
includes: Codes read, then the circuit and component actually tested rather than assumed
Live data recorded and compared against the manufacturer values
Road test where the fault only shows up driving
Written findings and a quote for the repair before anything is done
jobs.note: For faults a code read cannot settle on its own. The cost of a code read is deducted if you have already had one.

jobs.name: Warning light / fault finding
jobs.note: Every fault is different, so we start with a diagnostic check and quote the repair in writing before any work.

jobs.name: DPF light / loss of power (diesel)
jobs.note: We check the soot load and sensors first, then quote the right fix. We never remove DPFs.

jobs.name: Oil and filter change
includes: Castrol engine oil, drained and replaced with the exact grade your engine’s maker specifies
New oil filter and sump plug washer
Oil level set and the car checked for leaks before it goes out
Service light reset where the car has one
jobs.note: Oil and filter only. If you want the car looked over at the same time, the interim service is this job plus a 25-point inspection.

jobs.name: Interim service
includes: Castrol engine oil, drained and replaced with the exact grade your engine’s maker specifies
New oil filter and sump plug washer
All fluid levels topped up: coolant, brake fluid, screen wash, power steering
Tyre condition, tread depths and pressures set
Brake pads and discs inspected for wear
Lights, wipers, horn and battery condition checked
25-point visual health check, with anything found written down and priced before it is done
Service book stamped and the next service date set

jobs.name: Full service
includes: Everything in the interim service
New air filter
Brake fluid tested for moisture content
Suspension, steering joints and exhaust inspected on the ramp
Battery tested under load, charging system checked
Drive belt condition and tension checked
Underbody and engine bay inspected for leaks and corrosion
40-point inspection, with anything found written down and priced before it is done

jobs.name: Major service
includes: Everything in the full service
New cabin or pollen filter
Brake fluid changed, not just tested
Coolant strength tested and topped or changed to the manufacturer’s interval
Gearbox and differential oil levels checked
Air conditioning operation checked
Wheels off for a full brake inspection
60-point inspection, with anything found written down and priced before it is done

jobs.name: MOT test
jobs.note: MOT is outside VAT, so £50 is the whole price. The DVSA maximum is £54.85.

jobs.name: Tyre supply & fitting
jobs.note: Fitting, balancing and a new valve for £20 a tyre. Tell us your size and we'll send prices for budget, mid-range and premium tyres.

jobs.name: Stage 1 / Stage 2 ECU remap
jobs.note: We health-check the car first and quote once we know the engine and the map available. We never remove DPF, EGR or AdBlue systems.

jobs.name: Lowering springs fitted
jobs.note: Fitting price. Supply your own springs or we'll source them. Wheel alignment is advised afterwards.

jobs.name: Coilovers fitted & set up
jobs.note: Fitting and ride-height set-up. Parts supplied by you or sourced by us. Wheel alignment is advised afterwards.

jobs.name: Fit a set of alloy wheels
jobs.note: Four wheels fitted and balanced at £20 each. Tyres transferred or supplied separately.

recovery._pickup_note: Same figures as collection_inc_vat — collecting a car that drives is one job with one price, wherever the customer starts from.
recovery._road_factor_note: Postcodes give a straight-line distance; roads are longer. 1.3 is the usual multiplier for dense suburban London and keeps the banding honest rather than flattering.

_readme_model_bands: Model name -> size band, used when the DVLA lookup is unavailable so the customer is not asked to classify their own car. Keys are matched against the make and model they type, longest key first, after uppercasing and stripping punctuation. A model mapped to "van" beats the prestige-by-make rule (a Mercedes Sprinter is a van, not a prestige car); otherwise a prestige make wins. Add a line to correct a car we get wrong.

body_range._note: Every bodywork figure is shown as a band, because blending, prep and what is found behind the panel all move the final number. The band runs upward from the rate-card figure, never below it: the card price is the floor, so banding downward would quote under our own cost. Capped at max_fraction of the figure on a small job so it never swamps the price.

_readme_rates: Labour rates INC VAT. Ex VAT is inc / (1 + vat_rate): LOW £50, TOP £70, BODY £70. Retail has two tiers - LOW for servicing and brakes, TOP for everything else (SOP v8). The page shows the ex-VAT rate with 'plus VAT' after it, which is how KITH quotes. BODY is carried for reference only; bodywork prices off body_panels_ex_vat.
_readme_bodywork: Panel prices are SOP v4.8 panel painting, 5-seater base, ex VAT, with one exception: the front bumper is 240 rather than the SOP's 200, set by KITH on 16 Oct so a full respray prices above the localised repair. Light scuff / SMART is 240 inc VAT, also KITH's figure, against the SOP's 160. Blends are free per the SOP. No surcharge for aluminium, metallic, pearl or colour change. No multi-panel discount, though the SOP has a 20% second-panel rule. Size surcharges follow the SOP: +40 SUV, +100 van.

body_dent_uplift_ex_vat._note: Cost of pulling or filling the dent, on top of painting the panel. We do not do paintless repair, so there is no dent price that excludes paint. The spread is wide because severity is: a shallow door ding and a deep crease are not the same job.

alloy_refurb_ex_vat._note: Per wheel, ex VAT. £90 for a kerbed rim tidied and refinished, up to £120 where the face is badly gouged or the finish is diamond-cut. Confirmed when we see it.

service_matrix._note: Rows for the "what is included" table on the servicing pages. i = interim, f = full, m = major. Keep this in step with the includes lists on the three service jobs.
